tools.name: crm_bind
tools.note: ADR-0047 d6: an administrator binds a workspace to a record; members get derived grants that end with their membership. A link never grants access.

tools.name: desktop_read
tools.note: Desktop D1 (feature `desktop`, needs `crm`): the speaker's own desktop — layout, placements, pending suggestions. Dropped from the served manifest when `desktop` is off.

tools.name: desktop_arrange
tools.note: Direct only for the person, or a worker with the person in the loop in their own one-person chat (regime human, not shared); everything else is refused with propose_instead. Each change is an append-only version with Undo.

tools.name: desktop_arrange_propose
tools.note: Any agent turn: lands as a pending suggestion the person applies or dismisses with their own credential (POST /desk/proposal, not a tool). At most 5 pending per person, 20 per session per day, 7 days to live.

tools.name: workspace_settings_read
tools.note: The speaker's own workspace settings (pinned, hidden, muted, notify, room order, level, collapsed) on the CRM member_of relation; only slugs they changed. Rides `desktop` (a /desk/ route): dropped from the served manifest when it is off.

tools.name: workspace_settings_set
tools.note: A partial change to the speaker's own settings for one workspace. Direct only for the person, or a worker with the person in the loop in their own one-person chat; everything else is refused with person_only and nothing changes. Grants no access.

tools.name: card_list
tools.note: Desktop D2 (feature `desktop_cards`, needs `desktop` and `crm`): cards the speaker reads — a workspace's board, their own — and the proposals waiting for their answer. Dropped from the served manifest when `desktop_cards` is off.

tools.name: card_propose
tools.note: Any agent turn, watched or not: a proposed card (a change proposal with no record yet). A person accepts it with their own credential (crm_review): a writer of the workspace it was proposed into, or the person the agent acted for. Capped by card_proposals_pending_max / card_proposals_per_agent_per_day, expires after card_proposal_ttl_days. S5 (PRD 0.13.4 D11): with fields.Kind (commitment, approval, question, ask, invitation, policy_change) and fields.NextActor the card is made at once in its template's first stage and OFFERED to its next actor (status 'offered'): the card is the proposal, only that person's acknowledgement moves it, and the agent never moves it after. Capped by card_proposals_per_agent_per_day.

tools.name: card_update_propose
tools.note: A change or a stage move, always a proposal a member accepts (founder 2026-10-15, desktop ADR Q3: an agent never moves a card's stage).

publishes_events.triggers: crm_change_log v1 (a reference receipt, flows_defs/crm.py) and any person's routine on this event; since event.v2 (D8) the crm outbox seals an envelope whose audience reaches the next actor and the card's members, not only the actor
